segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often describe the mask as calming and non-irritating, but several others who also call their skin sensitive instead report redness, itching, whiteheads or an apparent allergic reaction, including two cases described as severe.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report a strong hydrating effect, describing skin that felt plump, soft and no longer tight, including one case of very dry, flaky winter skin becoming noticeably smoother after a single use.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who specifies combination oily/dry skin says the mask balanced her skin without increasing oiliness and helped heal existing acne.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with normal skin, who also has light rosacea on the chin and around the mouth, found the mask gentle on that more reactive area.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to late 50s who mention their age report smoother, firmer-looking skin, with visible softening of fine lines around the forehead and laugh lines.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report softer fine lines and improved elasticity, particularly around the forehead, eyes and laugh lines, though some describe the effect as visible but temporary rather than a lasting change.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most consistently reported benefit: reviewers with dry, tight or dull skin describe a strong plumping and hydrating effect felt immediately after use, though a few note the glow fades within a day or two.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some who call their skin sensitive, report their face turning red, hot or itchy after use — in a few cases resembling a sunburn or allergic reaction and lasting for days; other reviewers with sensitive skin or rosacea instead report no irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers frame the mask as supportive of a compromised barrier: one Accutane user says it helped guard against dehydration and barrier damage, another credits added probiotics with strengthening her skin barrier, echoing the brand's own claim.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers, including one with a lifelong history of acne, say the mask calmed breakouts or left skin clear, while others describe new whiteheads or a breakout appearing a few days after use.
concerns.oiliness: The few reviewers who mention oil levels say the mask left combination or oily-leaning skin balanced rather than shiny, without feeling drying either.

extraits.texte: The mask was easy to use - it comes in two thin gel lengths that peel from a plastic sheet and easily set to your face. (They do tear if you pinch or pull too hard. You have to be quite careful) I found that they adhered relatively quickly and felt mildly tingly for the first hour or so. I left it on overnight (roughly 7 hours) and was pleased with how soft my face felt when I washed it in the morning. It did leave a mildly sticky feeling residue immediately after removal. The mask had changed from a milky white to a clear sheet as advertised. As the day has worn on, I am increasingly unimpressed. My cheeks have stayed red and irritated, and now several whitehead pimples are forming that weren't there yesterday. While it was refreshing and helped with moisture this is NOT the glow I was going for. I will not be using the remaining product.

extraits.titre: Sensitive Skin? Wear it for less time
extraits.texte: It is not often that TikTok trends influence me to buy something, but I LOVE face masks, so I figured I'd give this one a try. I don't consider my skin particularly sensitive, but I have a skin type that will occasionally get irritated, like most people. The mask itself felt cool to wear, and the texture was soft and comfortable. The scent is light and not overpowering. I put it on at night before bed and peeled it off in the middle of the night, so I wore it for about 3 to 5 hours. When I got up in the morning, my face felt a little irritated. Over the span of the day, it became more itchy and even a little red. I rinsed my face off a couple of times, and it did not alleviate the itchy feeling. After using soap and water, my face felt smooth and no longer itchy. My face did feel softer than normal, so that might have been from the facemask. When I peeled it off, the mask was clear and dry. Supposedly the mask "turns clear when your skin absorbs the material", but the mask will turn clear if you leave it out as well, so that talking point I've seen on Tiktok may not be completely accurate. Anything you put on your skin will be absorbed. TL;DR: If you have sensitive skin, or are trying the product for the first time, wear it for the recommended 3 hours or even less, not overnight. My skin was itchy for a day afterward, but now feels soft. I will be trying the mask one more time with less wear time to see if I have the same reaction as when I wore it overnight.

extraits.titre: From my skin went from the Sahara Desert to a Tropical Oasis
extraits.texte: I live in Colorado and this winter has aged me 10 years. Seriously, my skin is dry and FLAKY. I am a make up girly and I literally haven’t even been able to apply make up lately because after 30 minutes of wearing any foundation my face looks like the surface of Mars. And let me tell you, after 4 hours of this mask I have transformed into a plump little baby. Is it witch craft? Maybe, do I care? Absolutely not. All of the sudden I’m back baby! I wore this mask on snowy day I decided to deep clean my house. I wore it for 4 hours and it stayed completely in place, no sliding or falling off. The entire time I wore wore it it feels very cooling, no burning or tingling (again, I have dry and irritated skin and I had no adverse reactions). It’s fun to watch it dissolve. My skin felt lovely & hydrated for the rest of the day and my make up finally looked normal again that night! (Yay!) If you’re a fellow victim of dreaded cursed dry skin, this is your saving grace. Stay strong this winter my friends. We’re in this together. Thank you magic Korean skin care mask, ily. I owe you.

Honestly put the hole punched part on my lips. Been using every day in the morning to hydrate my face. It takes a few hours to turn clear. Initial application you have to pay down to keep it from sliding off but once it starts absorbing it sticks to your skin (you can feel it ) you can get up and do things. Fits perfectly on my face (not too big or too small). Application is easy compared to sheet masks. It is thicker starting out and thins when ingredients are absorbing. Easy to peel off when it's done. Super sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. I have combination oily skin and this has balance my skin out where it's not dry or oily. Healed acne I had.

So, keep in mind here when viewing the photos, I’m 43 years old, so I’m no spring chicken. This is after one use. I’ll def be buying more and using them once or twice a week. My skin is very dry and super sensitive. I have rosacea and am allergic to chemical sunscreen, so I’ve got age spots and such from not knowing about physical sunscreen until last year. Just thought I couldn’t wear sunscreen, period. This mask felt cool, refreshing, and so nice on my skin. No tingling or burning. My skin feels so soft, hydrated, and five years younger. Just wow! Add to cart, buy, subscribe! You won’t regret it!

extraits.titre: Best Sheet Masks I’ve Tried: Hydrating, Firming, and Actually Stay Put!
extraits.texte: I love these sheet masks. For context, I’m 35 and focused on aging gracefully. I don’t do invasive procedures, so I rely on good skincare and quality products. I’m usually wary of sheet masks because most slide off my face and don’t have a visible effect on my skin, but these are hands-down some of the best I’ve tried. The design is brilliant: it’s split into two sections (top and bottom), so it fits securely and comfortably. The material clings to the skin without slipping, making it easy to wear while I work at my desk. I typically leave it on for about three hours, sometimes removing just the bottom half if I want to eat or snack. After each use, my skin looks plumper, smoother, and a lot more hydrated. I’ve noticed a visible difference in my fine lines, especially around my forehead and laugh lines, which is awesome! Pros: • Two-piece design fits comfortably and stays in place • Noticeable improvement in fine lines and skin texture • High-quality material that adheres well to the face • Long-lasting results with weekly use Cons: • Not ideal for overnight wear, they’re not comfortable enough to sleep in. Definitely more comfortable during the day
